hero_kpi_rationale: The number of Monthly Transacting Users (MTUs) is a key indicator of platform activity and growth at Coinbase, reflecting user engagement and revenue potential

kpis.name: Monthly Transacting Users
kpis.explanation: Number of users who conduct transactions on the platform at least once per month (28-day rolling period)
kpis.description: Indicator of platform engagement and growth

kpis.name: Assets on Platform
kpis.explanation: Total value of crypto-assets and stablecoins held or managed on behalf of customers in the platform's digital wallets
kpis.description: Indicator of customer trust and monetization opportunity
kpis.signal: Trend in value of assets held

kpis.name: Trading Volume
kpis.explanation: Total US dollar value of spot transactions executed on the platform, including half of the value of transactions routed off-platform
kpis.description: Indicator of trading activity and platform liquidity

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total platform revenue including transaction revenue and subscription and services revenue
kpis.description: Indicator of overall financial performance of the platform

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, adjusted to exclude certain non-recurring items
kpis.description: Indicator of operational performance and cash generation

kpis.name: USDC Market Capitalization
kpis.explanation: Total value of USDC held in Coinbase products, reflecting stablecoin adoption
kpis.description: Indicator of USDC stablecoin adoption and payments strategy

risks.title: Crypto Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly exposed to fluctuations in the crypto-asset market, which can have a significant impact on its operating results. The language used in the report is very cautious and emphasizes market uncertainty and volatility.

risks.title: Bitcoin Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on Bitcoin and Ethereum transactions, which may make it vulnerable to price fluctuations or technical issues.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to regulations and laws that may change and impact its operations. The report highlights the importance of regulation and legal compliance for the company.

risks.title: Security
risks.score_rationale: The company is vulnerable to security attacks and data losses, which could significantly impact its operations and reputation. The report emphasizes the importance of security for the company.

risks.title: Partnerships
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on third-party partnerships for certain operations, which may expose it to service delivery risks. The report underscores the importance of these partnerships to the company.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market, which may make it vulnerable to market share losses. The report highlights the significance of competition for the company.

ai_positioning.summary: Coinbase does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K report. The information provided focuses primarily on financial aspects, crypto-trading operations, stablecoins, and platform services, with no significant reference to AI.
